question: Which of the following is Russia's highest civilian honour given to the Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in July 2024?

options.text: Order of St. Andrew the Apostle

solution:
The correct answer is __**Order of St. Andrew the Apostle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Order of St. Andrew the Apostle** is the highest civilian honor in Russia, established in 1698 by Tsar Peter the Great.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional services to the state and society in Russia or for strengthening international relations with Russia.
 
• Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** was honored with the award in July 2024 for his contributions to fostering strong ties between India and Russia.
 
• The award is named after **St. Andrew, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ**, and is symbolized by a blue sash and a gold insignia.
 
• The honor highlights the importance of India-Russia strategic partnership in areas such as defense, energy, space, and trade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of the Order:**

 
 
• It was the first and highest order of chivalry in Russia, created by Peter the Great in 1698 to honor military and civilian merit.
 
• After the fall of the Russian Empire in 1917, the order was discontinued but reinstated in 1998 by the Russian Federation.
 
 
 
• **St. Andrew the Apostle:**
 
 
• St. Andrew was one of Jesus Christ's apostles and is considered the patron saint of Russia.
 
• The order is named after him as a symbol of courage, devotion, and service.
 
 
 
• **India-Russia Relations:**
 
 
• India and Russia have a strong bilateral relationship, with collaborations in defense, space, energy, and trade.
 
• The two countries have a history of supporting each other on global platforms, including the United Nations.
 
 
 
• **Similar International Honors:**
 
 
• PM Narendra Modi has also received other prestigious international awards, such as the UAE's Order of Zayed and the United Nations' Champions of the Earth Award.
 
• These honors recognize his global leadership and contributions to international cooperation.
